name: Salade nicoise with tuna
steps: Boil the baby potatoes and green beans until just tender, then cool.
Halve the boiled eggs and cherry tomatoes.
Arrange the lettuce, potatoes and beans in a bowl.
Flake the tuna over the top and scatter the olives.
Add the egg halves and tomatoes around the bowl.
Whisk olive oil with a squeeze of lemon and drizzle over.
